api: create/reopen/receive/analyse/review/report/csv/hash/canonical/parseCSV/samples follow prior complete DetailDay API; preserved source-bound immutable editions and complete wrapper

semantics.base: Same independently checked full interval resources/availability/quotes/completions/invoices/payments/allocations with groomer, station, client, pet, appointment names.
semantics.series: Stable source-defined client/pet/service identity, cadence_label is descriptive; active/paused/ended. No invented future appointments.
semantics.expected_visits: Every expected occurrence is explicit original source with sequence and zoned timestamps/recorded_at. No recurrence expansion or UTC cadence inference. A skipped/cancelled occurrence remains visible; multiple active appointments linked to one occurrence get attention.
semantics.policy_versions: Explicit service policy identity and retained terms; notice_basis elapsed_minutes, business_hours or manual. notice_minutes only supplied for explicit elapsed_minutes; others remain manual without business-calendar inference. Accepted policy version stays attached to exact booking revision.
semantics.booking_revisions: series_id and occurrence_id both present or both empty; service_id always present. policy_id/accepted_at both present or empty; preferred_language explicit source language string. Series client/pet/service identity stable. Appointment recurrence identity stable across revisions; reschedule preserves original occurrence.
semantics.decisions: Source observations kind cancel,reschedule,no_show,waive,transfer,other; exact appointment/revision binding. Declared notice_received_at optional, cannot follow decided_at; recorded authorization mandatory. Selected as-of hides future decisions. Attention compares elapsed notice against exact accepted policy when applicable and records operator decision. No automatic charge, refund or calendar mutation.
semantics.communications: Exact appointment/revision-bound record. kind reminder,confirmation,ready_for_pickup,report_card,other. outcome queued,sent,delivered,failed,cancelled. sent_at optional unless sent/delivered; explicit observationtime governsasof. Missing preferred language stays unknown. Detect duplicates only samekind/revision/scheduled_for/recipient in actual sent/delivered records. Late messages tied to earlier changed/cancelled revision flagged without assumingwithdrawal.
semantics.completions: Observed physical work independent of scheduled status. Original incomplete interval ends at observation time.
semantics.money: Same exact minor-unit/parent refund/job matching. Deposit transfers require actual source allocations and authorization; policy and decision records never calculate or mutate money.

status: Complete engine checkpoint; same stable contract. Expected visits also report durationDeltaMinutes; duplicate message scheduled instants compare by actual timestamp.
